title: Boston Gas Company submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy, (i) a 365 Day Transportation Agreement; (ii) a Marginal Cost Analysis; and (iii) a comparison of the estimated revenues under the proposed contract with the Company's G-54T Rates Schedule for Tilcon Capaldi, Inc.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protecition from public disclosure. Commissioners participaing were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-23)
